parsed.main_gap: The set Q is defined as primes dividing A, but the lemma requires Q to contain every prime at most A.

errors.description: This equality is false for the stated Q. For A=15 and the listed term x=18, σ(x)={3} while P(x)={2,3}; moreover {3} is not good because 20 is a term. Redefining Q as all primes at most A repairs the proof.
errors.quote: If all prime factors of \(x\) are at most \(A\), then \(\sigma(x)=P(x)\)

parsed.notes: Apart from this inconsistent definition, the induction and periodicity argument are coherent. The correction is local: take Q to be all primes not exceeding A and L their product.
